राध् + अ,
 I. m. The month Vaiśākha, April--May.
 II. f. धा.
 1. The sixteenth lunar asterism.
 2. The favourite mistress of Kṛṣṇa, Pañc. 45, 2.
 3. The wife of the charioteer of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, by whom Karṇa was fostered.
 4.
